Track 1: Getting Started

UAE E-Invoicing Overview

The UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA) is modernizing tax collection by mandating structured, digital e-invoicing for all business-to-business (B2B) and business-to-government (B2G) transactions.

Official Mandate

Regulated by the UAE Federal Tax Authority (FTA) to prevent tax evasion and automate tax compliance recording.

Decentralized Trust

Instead of a centralized FTA portal for uploading, invoices flow through accredited Access Points directly between buyers and sellers.

Structured Standard

Adopts the global PEPPOL PINT standard, localized as PINT AE XML, replacing unstructured PDF or paper documents.

Implementation Roadmap

Q2 2024

PEPPOL Authority Declaration

UAE FTA announces adoption of PEPPOL as the foundation for the national e-invoicing model.

Q4 2024

PINT AE Spec Release

Release of PEPPOL PINT AE (UAE specifications) and local Schematron business rules.

Q2 2025

Service Provider Accreditations

FTA begins accrediting Access Point providers (ASPs) for the local market.

Dec 2025

Phase 1 Mandate Go-Live

Mandatory B2B & B2G e-invoicing compliance for large tax groups and enterprise sellers.

2026

Phase 2 Mandate Expansion

Gradual onboarding of mid-market and SME taxpayers into the PEPPOL network.
